posts.title: November Again
posts.description: Novel writing time is upon us once again! I'm so grateful for steno.

posts.title: Hardware Showcase
posts.description: Did you know the Plover Discord has a #hardware-showcase channel? It's pretty dang cool. Here's a recent favorite, from user aarondot: My "portable" learning setup--geonix rev 2.5 with custom keycaps from yuzu, Bluetooth into a retroid pocket flip 2 running dotterel I especially like the example sentences. Already a pretty far distance from "the ape sat at the top step", which I believe was the first complete sentence I ever learned to write in steno school.
